adjudicated.jp: なるほど確かにこれはマズイ。
adjudicated.en: I see, it's certain, this is very bad.
comments: See CCC3025 now. Specific wording seen in reference to Youko. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: なるほど確かに means roughly 'I see—this really is bad.' The English strings two discourse markers and two finite clauses together with commas.

highlights.text: I see, it's certain, this is very bad.

adjudicated.jp: 口元が酷薄そうに吊り上がっていた。
adjudicated.en: The edges of my mouth lifted in apparent inhuman cruelty.
comments: Odd way to specify it, meaning it might just well be his impression... or wish. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: 酷薄そう describes the mouth as looking cold or cruel. 'Inhuman cruelty' substantially intensifies the judgment.

adjudicated.en: I ended up estranged from Kiri.

adjudicated.jp: 部活にもあまり顔を出さなくなった。
adjudicated.en: She nearly stopped showing face at club.
adjudicated.assessment: The idiom is 'show her face,' and the club requires a determiner in this construction.

adjudicated.jp: 美希が強引に連れてくることはあったが、俺のことは避けた。
adjudicated.en: There were times when Miki would forcibly bring her along, but she avoided me.
comments: And what did Kiri tell her? Who knows. Maybe that's when she decided to be the Villain. -GHS
